chapters.title: Introduction to External File Storage Module
Setting up File Accounts and Storage Configuration
Demonstration of File Storage in Action

features.name: External File Storage System Application Module
features.description: A new system application module that provides an API to connect to and store data in external file storage systems including Azure blob storage, Azure file share, and SharePoint online.
caveats: There is no uptake of it yet in the base application
Developers need to create their own implementations

features.name: File Accounts Page
features.description: A user interface page for configuring file storage accounts, similar to the email accounts pattern, allowing setup of blob storage, file share, or SharePoint connections.

features.name: File Scenarios Enum
features.description: An extensible enum that allows developers to define custom file scenarios for different use cases, such as saving order confirmations or other document types.
caveats: Initially no built-in scenarios in the base application

features.name: External File Storage API Methods
features.description: API methods including Initialize, OpenFileDialog/SaveFileDialog, and CreateFile that enable developers to programmatically store files in external storage systems like Azure blob storage.

features.name: Storage Browser
features.description: A browser interface that allows users to view and manage files stored in external file storage accounts, similar to file explorers.
